title: Relay Hymnist
text: Relay Hymnist threads a rigid chant through abandoned towers and turns the whole lane into an instrument. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Every mast remembers one forbidden verse.

defeatReward.text: Relay Hymnist is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
